questions.question: A CDL is required to operate:
answers: Certain commercial motor vehicles by weight/passenger/hazmat criteria

questions.question: Hours of Service rules exist to:
answers: Prevent fatigued driving by limiting driving/on-duty time

questions.question: Pre-trip inspections should include:
answers: Lights, tires, brakes, coupling, fluids, and safety equipment
Nothing if the truck looks fine

questions.question: HazMat placards indicate:
answers: Hazardous materials class/division for emergency responders

questions.question: Backing a commercial vehicle is safest when:
answers: Using a spotter when available and checking mirrors constantly

questions.question: Double-clutching is used to:
answers: Match engine and transmission speeds in non-synchro transmissions

questions.question: If you are cited for a serious traffic violation in a CMV:
answers: It may affect CDL privileges even in a personal vehicle

questions.question: Passenger endorsement is needed to:
answers: Transport passengers in vehicles requiring a CDL passenger endorsement

questions.question: Bridge laws / weight distribution matter because:
answers: Axle weights and spacing protect infrastructure and affect legality

questions.question: Emergency triangles should be placed:
answers: At prescribed distances behind/ahead of a stopped CMV

questions.question: Alcohol while on duty for CDL holders:
answers: Has stricter prohibited conduct and lower BAC limits

questions.question: Retarders (engine/exhaust brakes) should be used carefully when:
answers: Road surfaces are slippery because they can cause drive-wheel skids

questions.question: A convex mirror helps you:
answers: See a wider area beside/behind the vehicle

questions.question: Cargo that shifts in transit can:
answers: Cause rollover or loss of control

questions.question: When approaching a scale / weigh station:
answers: Follow posted directions; open stations may require entry

questions.question: Defensive driving for CDL operators emphasizes:
answers: Scanning, space, speed management, and anticipating others

questions.question: Air line glad hands connect:
answers: Tractor and trailer brake air systems

questions.question: If brakes fade on a long downgrade:
answers: Downshift earlier next time; stop safely if possible and cool brakes
Shift to neutral and coast faster

questions.question: Passenger stops require:
answers: Leaving the vehicle unlocked with keys inside always
Safe procedures for boarding/alighting and securement as required

questions.question: Logbooks / ELDs record:
answers: Duty status and driving time for compliance
